source: crates/successor-sim command_manifest over successor_net::ClientCommand plus current TypeScript authority wire commands
regenerationCommand: cargo run -p successor-sim --bin emit_command_manifest -- tools/codegen/generated/successor.commands.manifest.v1.json && node tools/codegen/commands.mjs

commands.doc: Move the controlled actor by one bounded grid vector for a short duration.
Set the held movement vector used by continuous player locomotion.
Queue a roll-combat action against a target; basic_shot arms the server repeat intent.

durableIntent.notes: One accepted basic_shot arms owner repeat fire until cancelled, peace, invalid target, or dismissal.

commands.doc: Request peace and dismiss queued combat repeat/entries for the controlled player-like actor.
Cancel one ability queue entry or a queue scope such as owner_repeat, combat, posture, or all.
Reload a weapon from available ammunition or a stockpile.
Equip or clear a weapon by weapon enum and optional inventory item id.
Equip or unequip one owned clothing inventory instance; loot clothing requires exact stack and variant.
Debug-only item grant command gated by GAME_DEBUG_AUTHORITY_COMMANDS.
Debug-only skill-box grant command gated by GAME_DEBUG_AUTHORITY_COMMANDS.
Debug-only wallet adjustment gated by GAME_DEBUG_AUTHORITY_COMMANDS. Negative amounts drain and clamp at zero.
Use an area transition trigger by id.
Use a consumable by string item id and optional numeric item/variant ids.
Refill an ammo item stack from authority inventory/stockpile state.
Apply a service buff effect to the controlled actor.
Respawn through a clone facility, optionally naming the facility id.
Revive a target actor using available authority medical state.
Queue or apply a kneel/stand posture change.
Sample a resource family into the player's inventory and arm a durable auto-repeat loop; stop=true cancels the loop.

durableIntent.notes: Accepted sampling repeats server-side every RESOURCE_SAMPLE_AUTO_REPEAT_CADENCE_TICKS until movement, posture break, area change, death, or stop=true.

commands.doc: Move an exact carried stack quantity into the owning character bank.
Move an exact bank stack quantity into carried inventory.
Deposit positive wallet credits into the owning character bank.
Withdraw positive bank credits into the wallet.
Save or update the profession backup for clone restoration, costing 1000 credits after the implicit initial backup.
Take all remaining credits from a public player corpse.
Survey nearby spawns for a resource family and emit a survey result.
Place one carried extractor for a surveyed resource family at the actor's current position.

durableIntent.notes: One accepted placement persists a server-owned extractor until collected or destroyed.

commands.doc: Start manual extraction on an owned nearby extractor; standing actors enter the kneel-down lock first.

durableIntent.notes: The actor keeps cranking until StopCrank, stand/move/death, range failure, or hopper full.

commands.doc: Stop the actor's current manual extractor crank, if any.
Consume one owned extractor battery stack and start autonomous extraction on a nearby owned extractor.

durableIntent.notes: A battery keeps extracting until power depletes, the hopper fills, or the extractor is destroyed.

commands.doc: Collect whole resource units from an owned nearby extractor hopper into inventory.
Remove an owned nearby extractor, discarding hopper contents and returning the device item.
Pitch the carried camp kit at the actor's position, spawning a one-per-player scout camp (weather-shelter zone). Consumes the kit.

durableIntent.notes: One accepted placement persists a server-owned scout camp until packed up or auto-torn-down after the abandonment grace.

commands.doc: Strike the actor's own nearby scout camp, freeing the one-per-player slot. The kit was consumed on placement (single-use rule), so nothing is returned.
Split quantity out of an inventory stack.
Discard an entire exact carried inventory stack owned by the acting player.
Merge one inventory stack into another stack in the same container.
Redeem a Credit Chip stack from a player-owned container into the credit balance; the chip's quantity is its face value and the stack is consumed.
Harvest all creature resources from a corpse: Hide, Meat, and Bone.
Take a loot stack from a corpse/cache container.
Purchase a travel ticket from a terminal to a destination planet/city.
Consume a travel ticket and move to its recorded destination.
Toggle an interactive door prop near the actor.
Craft a schematic with allocated experimentation points.
Begin a multi-step crafting session for an unlocked recipe.
Assign an exact inventory resource stack to a crafting session slot.
Clear a slot assignment before assembly.
Consume assigned resources and assemble the prototype shell.

durableIntent.notes: Accepted assembly consumes the exact assigned resource stacks; later cancel is lossy.

commands.doc: Spend experimentation points on one assembled prototype stat line.
Finalize an assembled prototype into the crafted inventory item.
Complete assembled practice without creating an item.
Mint a drafted factory schematic handle from an assembled prototype.
Spend one physical drafted schematic run at a factory workbench.
Cancel the active crafting session; after assembly this is lossy.
Ask a craftsman trainer to issue any missing Field Multitool and Mineral Survey Tool from the starter bundle.
Purchase/train a skill box from a trainer actor.
Unlearn one skill box through a trainer, refunding its skill-point cost.
Set or clear the active profession title.
Set the actor career goal through a trainer actor.
Move a quantity from actor inventory into exchange storage.
Retrieve a quantity from exchange storage into actor inventory.
Propose a bilateral trade offer/request with another actor.
Accept a pending trade proposal.
Decline or cancel a pending trade proposal.
Add an item line to the sender's own side of an open trade session (clears both accept-locks).
Remove an item line from the sender's own side of an open trade session (clears both accept-locks).
Set the sender's own wallet-credit offer on an open trade session (clears both accept-locks).
Final OK on a fully-locked trade session; both confirms execute the atomic swap.
Invite a player into your group; a solo inviter forms a new group on accept.
Accept your pending group invite, joining the inviter's group.
Decline your pending group invite.
Leave your current group; deterministic leader succession applies.
Disband your group entirely; leader only.
Remove a member from your group; leader only, cannot target self.
Challenge a specific player to a consensual 1v1 duel; expires like a group invite.
Accept your pending duel challenge, forming the duel and opening damage within the pair.
Decline your pending duel challenge.
Yield your active duel; the yielder concedes and lives, the opponent wins.
Explicitly finish a downed opponent in your active duel at close range.
Sample a deterministic wild-flora landrace seed of a crop species with the Gene Sampler.
Reveal a seed's genome with the Genome Scanner; depth is gated by the Sequencing track.
Open a splice session for a crop species at a Splice Bench (Bio-Engineer).
Assign a parent seed (slots 0-1) or a reagent (slots 2-5) to the splice session.
Clear a splice session slot before assembly.
Directed segregation choice: pick which allele (0/1) to take from a parent (0/1) at a locus.
Consume parents + reagents and compute deterministic per-locus base/cap lines (point of no return).

durableIntent.notes: Accepted assembly consumes the assigned parent seeds and reagents; later cancel is lossy.

commands.doc: Spend experimentation points to lift one assembled locus deterministically toward its cap.
Intern the child genome into the registry and hand the breeder the new seed handle.
Cancel the active splice session; after assembly the consumed inputs are not returned.
Stake a mini-mayor land claim (max 2 globally per character); spends wallet credits at a Land Registry terminal.

durableIntent.notes: Each accepted claim persists a server-owned parcel until abandoned; a character may hold at most two globally.

commands.doc: Release an owned parcel; returns placed structure items, crops are lost. Frees one global claim slot.
Rename an owned parcel (owner-only cosmetic).
Pay light periodic credit upkeep on an owned parcel; lapse pauses the farm, never confiscates.
Hoe a farm-yard cell into tillable soil.
Plant one seed on a tilled tile; caches the projected AgronomicProfile (seed->soil boundary).
Scythe a tile: remove its crop, keep the soil tilled (dry).
Water a tile: settle growth to now, then refill moisture and revive a dormant crop from saved progress.
Kneel and auto-tend the plot on a cadence (waters dry tiles, settles growth) until you move/stand/leave; stop=true cancels.

durableIntent.notes: Accepted tending repeats server-side every cadence until movement, stand, area change, death, loss of ownership, or stop=true.

commands.doc: Place a farm structure (W3: irrigation sprinkler) inside a parcel; consumes the 6_3xx item.
Remove an owned parcel's farm structure; returns the item.
Place a catalogued one-level building component inside an owned parcel build zone.
Remove an owned building component and return its deterministic salvage.
Toggle an owned sliding building door between open and closed states.
Apply one soil amendment (speed/quality/yield) to a tilled tile; one kind per tile, consumes the fertilizer item.
Harvest a mature crop: mint produce + offspring seeds (mint_harvest_seed; sterile => none) + regrowth reset or clear to tilled.
Create a guild at the player's authorized public-affairs terminal.
Invite another actor to join the player's guild.
Accept a pending guild invitation.
Decline a pending guild invitation.
Leave the player's current guild.
Remove a target member from the player's guild.
Set a guild member's role.
Set a guild member's permission bit mask.
Transfer guild leadership to another member.
Declare war on another guild.
Accept an incoming guild war request.
Rescind an outgoing guild war request.
Disband the player's guild.
